## Ghar se door bachche: Bihar ke audit ne kya dikhaya

Jo bachche kisi institution mein rehte hain, unke liye shaam ko gate par koi maa-baap intezaar nahi karta. Tata Institute of Social Sciences ne state government ke liye Bihar ke children's homes ka social audit kiya, jo April 2018 mein submit hua. Isme kai institutions mein sexual abuse ki baat saamne aayi, jinmein Muzaffarpur ka ek state-funded girls' shelter home bhi tha [[newslaundry-tiss-audit-bihar-2018]]. Audit se us home mein 34 minor ladkiyon ka sexual abuse saamne aaya [[sc-handbook-child-rights-2025]]. 20 January 2020 ko Delhi ke Saket ki ek POCSO court ne, jahan Supreme Court ne trial transfer kiya tha, 20 mein se 19 accused ko convict kiya; baad mein 11 ko umar qaid ki saza hui [[scconline-muzaffarpur-sentence-2020]].

Ladkiyan state ki apni dekhbhaal mein thi, aur abuse saamne laane ke liye ek bahar ke audit ki zaroorat padi. Aaj Mission Vatsalya, jo 2021-22 se Centre ki child protection scheme hai, Child Welfare Committees aur District Child Protection Units ke saath child care institutions ko bhi fund karti hai [[mwcd-mission-vatsalya-guidelines-2022]]. Kaagazi inspection un bahar walon ki jagah nahi le sakta jo bachchon se baat karte hain.

Disability wale bachchon ke saamne deewar aur oonchi hai. Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ke Section 92(d) ke tahat, jo insaan kisi disabled bachche ya aurat ki marzi par haavi hone ki position mein ho aur us position ka istemaal uska sexual exploitation karne ke liye kare, use 6 mahine se 5 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai; rape ki saza BNS ke tahat alag se hai [[gazette-rpwd-act-2016]]. Jab koi disabled survivor sexual offence report karti hai, toh police ko uski complaint uske ghar ya uski pasand ki jagah par, interpreter ya special educator ke saath, video par record karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Ek asli child protection policy mein kya hota hai

Apne bachche ke school, hostel, coaching centre ya children's home se uski likhit child protection policy maangiye. Ek serious policy mein yeh sab hota hai:

- **Kaun report karega, aur kise.** Ek tay insaan jo usi din police ko batata hai, na ki koi committee jo tay kare ki batana hai ya nahi.
- **Access.** Band darwaze ke peeche one-to-one time nahi; coaching, transport aur hostel ki night duty aise ho ki koi doosra adult dekh sake.
- **Contact.** Staff aur kisi akele bachche ke beech private social media chats ya der raat ke messages nahi.
- **Checks.** Har staff member ka background aur police verification, drivers, guards aur cooks samet.
- **Accused.** Police investigation ke dauraan use bachchon se door rakha jaye, bilkul waise hi jaise POCSO police se kehta hai ki bachche ko accused se door rakhe [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].
- **Privacy.** Bachche ka naam, photo aur class kabhi share na ho, staff ya parents ke WhatsApp groups mein bhi nahi. POCSO aisi kisi bhi media report par rok lagata hai jo child victim ka naam, school ya family details zaahir kare [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].
- **Training.** Staff ko grooming ke signs sikhaye jayein; bachchon ko bataya jaye ki woh kise bata sakte hain.

Agar koi institution yeh sab nahi dikha sakta, toh poochiye kyun.

## Agar institution complaint ko daba de

Police ke paas jaane ke liye aapko institution ki permission, ya uski inquiry, ki zaroorat nahi hai. Har police station ko complaint record karni hogi, chahe offence kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR); complaint electronically bhi bheji ja sakti hai, aur aapko uski copy free milegi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Child Helpline 1098 [[wcd-childline]] par call kijiye, ya agar bachcha abhi khatre mein hai toh 112 par.

Complaint record karne se mana karna khud ek offence hai: POCSO ke tahat 6 mahine tak ki jail [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], aur BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat rape ya sexual assault ki complaint record na karne wale police officer ko 6 mahine se 2 saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Apni complaint mein us head ka naam likhiye jise pata tha aur jisne kuch nahi kiya; POCSO ka Section 21 ise bhi offence banata hai. Children's home ka maamla ho, toh zile ki Child Welfare Committee ko bhi likhiye.

Record rakhiye ki aapne kise bataya, kab bataya, aur unhone kya jawab diya. Accused ko hatane ki maang kijiye, apne bachche ko nahi. Jis bachche ne abuse report kiya, use sach bolne ki keemat school, team ya ghar kho kar nahi chukaani chahiye.

seva-child-marriage-judgment-2024.en:
On 18 October 2024, a Supreme Court bench of Chief Justice D.Y. Chandrachud and Justices J.B. Pardiwala and Manoj Misra decided Society for Enlightenment and Voluntary Action v. Union of India, a writ petition filed in 2017 [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. India had outlawed child marriage under a 2006 Act, yet the law was barely used. The court did not answer with a harsher punishment. It wrote a manual for the state, organised around one line: "prevention before protection and protection before penalisation".

## The petition and the problem it raised

When the petition was filed, the latest national survey, NFHS-4 (2015-16), had found that 26.8% of women aged 20-24 had married before 18. NFHS-5 (2019-21) put it at 23.3% [[ceda-genderstats-underage-marriage-2021]]. The fall was real but slowing, and the law meant to speed it up was rarely enforced.

On paper, the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 (PCMA) had the tools. It punishes an adult man who marries a child and anyone who performs, promotes or permits such a marriage. It provides for Child Marriage Prohibition Officers, and it lets courts stop a planned child marriage with an injunction; a marriage held in breach of one is void [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. The case was about why those tools so rarely worked.

## What the court found: weak penalties, few FIRs

The court started with the penalties. For an adult groom, for whoever performs the marriage and for whoever promotes or permits it, the PCMA's maximum is two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs 1 lakh, with no minimum sentence. That absence, the court said, "has led to ineffective enforcement of the PCMA" [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

It then looked at figures states had submitted for the previous three years [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]:

| State | Child marriage cases reported | FIRs |
|---|---|---|
| Telangana | 4,440 | 149 |
| Andhra Pradesh | about 3,400, most stopped | 10 |
| Maharashtra | 2,043 prevented | 178 |
| Tamil Nadu | 8,966 | 2,392 |

Read these with care. Most "cases" were weddings stopped before they happened, and a stopped wedding need not end in an FIR. The judgment gives two slightly different totals for Andhra Pradesh, and it does not say which three years the figures cover [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Still, the pattern is plain. Adults who arranged a child's marriage rarely faced a police case, and Tamil Nadu shows that a state can choose differently.

## The guidelines: officers, units, magistrates and auspicious days

The directions are specific [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]:

- States and union territories must appoint officers at district level whose only job is the work of a Child Marriage Prohibition Officer.
- Each state must publish these officers' quarterly reports on its official website.
- Each state must set up a special child marriage prohibition unit.
- Magistrates are to act on their own, issuing injunctions to stop child marriages, with special attention to "auspicious days" known for mass weddings.
- District Collectors and Superintendents of Police are responsible for prevention, and officials who neglect the work face action.

Behind them sits a philosophy:

> "The orientation of these guidelines is to prioritise prevention before protection and protection before penalisation."

The court warned that law enforcement "must not be solely focused on increasing prosecutions without making the best efforts to prevent and prohibit child marriage", while making clear that it was not discouraging prosecution [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Consider how this is meant to work. An officer with no other duties hears that a hall has been booked for a mass wedding on an auspicious date, and that one bride is 15. A magistrate can issue an injunction days ahead. If the family goes ahead anyway, the marriage is void, and the girl never has to go to court herself to undo it.

## Betrothals and personal laws: left to Parliament

Two questions the court chose not to settle. On betrothals, it noted that the PCMA is silent, that marriages fixed in childhood violate a child's "free choice, autonomy, agency and childhood", and that Parliament "may consider outlawing child betrothals" [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. That is advice, not a binding direction.

On personal laws, it declined to rule on whether the PCMA overrides them. It pointed instead to the Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021, introduced on 21 December 2021 to raise women's minimum age of marriage from 18 to 21 and to make the Act override any other law, custom or practice, and called the issue "pending consideration before Parliament" [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. But a Bill pending in the Lok Sabha lapses when the House is dissolved, and the 17th Lok Sabha had been dissolved in June 2024, four months before the judgment. The Bill's status could not be confirmed. If it lapsed, the court handed the question to a Bill that was no longer before Parliament.

## Two years on: what can and cannot be verified

More than two years later, whether states have appointed officers with no other duties, published quarterly reports and set up special units could not be verified for this article.

National data cannot settle it either. Police registered 1,499 child marriage cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], down from 6,038 in 2023, when Assam alone accounted for 5,267 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. Swings like that reflect enforcement, not how many weddings took place, and the judgment came with only about ten weeks of 2024 left. In 2024, courts recorded 209 convictions and 625 acquittals under the Act, and 8,553 cases were still pending at the year's end [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The newest survey, NFHS-6, found 20.1% of women aged 20-24 married before 18, but its fieldwork ended on 31 December 2024, and it records weddings from years earlier [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

That leaves the one record the court designed for public checking: the quarterly report. If the guidelines are being followed, those reports exist, district by district, on official websites. Any reader can look for them. If they are missing, that is an answer too.
seva-child-marriage-judgment-2024.hg:
18 October 2024 ko Chief Justice D.Y. Chandrachud aur Justices J.B. Pardiwala aur Manoj Misra ki Supreme Court bench ne Society for Enlightenment and Voluntary Action v. Union of India case ka faisla sunaya, jo 2017 mein daayar ek writ petition thi [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. India ne 2006 ke ek Act se child marriage ko gair-kaanooni bana diya tha, phir bhi yeh law mushkil se hi istemaal hota tha. Court ne jawaab mein koi sakht saza nahi di. Usne state ke liye ek manual likha, jo ek line pe tika hai: "prevention before protection and protection before penalisation", yaani pehle roktham, phir suraksha, aur saza sabse baad mein.

## Petition aur uska uthaya sawaal

Jab petition daayar hui, tab ke sabse naye national survey, NFHS-4 (2015-16), ne paaya tha ki 20-24 saal ki 26.8% women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein yeh 23.3% tha [[ceda-genderstats-underage-marriage-2021]]. Giravat asli thi lekin dheemi pad rahi thi, aur jis law ko ise tez karna tha, woh shaayad hi kabhi laagu hota tha.

Kaagaz pe Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 (PCMA) ke paas saare auzaar the. Yeh us adult mard ko saza deta hai jo kisi child se shaadi kare, aur har us insaan ko jo aisi shaadi karwaye, uska badhawa de ya use hone de. Ismein Child Marriage Prohibition Officers ka provision hai, aur court injunction dekar plan ki gayi child marriage rok sakti hai; injunction todkar hui shaadi void hoti hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Case is baat pe tha ki yeh auzaar itna kam kaam kyun karte the.

## Court ne kya paaya: kamzor sazaayein, kam FIRs

Court ne sazaon se shuruaat ki. Adult dulhe ke liye, shaadi karwane wale ke liye, aur uska badhawa dene ya use hone dene wale ke liye PCMA ki maximum saza do saal ki rigorous imprisonment aur Rs 1 lakh ka jurmana hai, aur koi minimum saza nahi. Court ne kaha ki minimum saza ki yeh kami "has led to ineffective enforcement of the PCMA", yaani isi wajah se law theek se laagu nahi hua [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Phir court ne woh figures dekhe jo states ne pichhle teen saalon ke liye diye the [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]:

| State | Report hue child marriage cases | FIRs |
|---|---|---|
| Telangana | 4,440 | 149 |
| Andhra Pradesh | lagbhag 3,400, zyadatar roki gayi | 10 |
| Maharashtra | 2,043 roki gayi | 178 |
| Tamil Nadu | 8,966 | 2,392 |

Inhe dhyaan se padhiye. Zyadatar "cases" woh shaadiyan thi jo hone se pehle rok di gayi, aur ruki hui shaadi pe FIR hona zaroori nahi. Judgment Andhra Pradesh ke liye do thode alag totals deta hai, aur yeh nahi batata ki figures kaunse teen saalon ke hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Phir bhi pattern saaf hai. Jin badon ne kisi bachche ki shaadi tay ki, unpe police case shaayad hi kabhi hua, aur Tamil Nadu dikhata hai ki koi state alag raasta chun sakta hai.

## Guidelines: officers, units, magistrates aur 'auspicious days'

Directions saaf-saaf hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]:

- States aur union territories district level pe aise officers appoint karein jinka sirf ek kaam ho: Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ka kaam.
- Har state in officers ki quarterly reports apni official website pe publish kare.
- Har state ek special child marriage prohibition unit banaye.
- Magistrates khud pehal karke child marriages rokne ke injunctions jaari karein, aur mass weddings ke liye jaane jaane wale "auspicious days" pe khaas dhyaan dein.
- District Collectors aur Superintendents of Police roktham ke zimmedaar hain, aur kaam mein laaparwaahi karne wale officials pe action hoga.

Inke peeche ek soch hai:

> "The orientation of these guidelines is to prioritise prevention before protection and protection before penalisation."

Yaani in guidelines ka focus pehle roktham, phir suraksha, aur saza sabse baad mein hai. Court ne chetaavni di ki law enforcement "must not be solely focused on increasing prosecutions without making the best efforts to prevent and prohibit child marriage", yaani child marriage rokne ki poori koshish kiye bina sirf prosecutions badhane pe focus nahi hona chahiye; saath hi court ne saaf kiya ki woh prosecution ko discourage nahi kar rahi [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Sochiye yeh kaise kaam karna chahiye. Ek officer, jiska koi aur kaam nahi, sunta hai ki ek shubh date pe mass wedding ke liye hall book hua hai, aur ek dulhan 15 saal ki hai. Magistrate kuch din pehle hi injunction jaari kar sakta hai. Agar family phir bhi shaadi kar de, toh woh shaadi void hai, aur ladki ko use khatam karwane ke liye khud kabhi court nahi jaana padta.

## Sagaai aur personal laws: Parliament pe chhode gaye

Do sawaal court ne tay nahi kiye. Sagaai yaani betrothal pe court ne note kiya ki PCMA is pe chup hai, ki bachpan mein tay ki gayi shaadiyan bachche ki "free choice, autonomy, agency and childhood" ka ulanghan karti hain, aur ki Parliament "may consider outlawing child betrothals", yaani child betrothals ko ban karne pe vichaar kar sakti hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Yeh salaah hai, binding direction nahi.

Personal laws pe court ne yeh faisla karne se mana kar diya ki PCMA unse upar hai ya nahi. Uski jagah usne Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021 ki taraf ishaara kiya, jo 21 December 2021 ko pesh hua tha taaki women ki shaadi ki minimum umar 18 se 21 ho aur Act har doosre law, custom ya practice se upar rahe, aur kaha ki yeh mudda "pending consideration before Parliament" hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Lekin Lok Sabha mein pending Bill House dissolve hone pe lapse ho jaata hai, aur 17th Lok Sabha judgment se chaar mahine pehle, June 2024 mein, dissolve ho chuki thi. Bill ka status confirm nahi ho saka. Agar woh lapse ho gaya tha, toh court ne yeh sawaal ek aise Bill ke hawale kar diya jo Parliament ke saamne tha hi nahi.

## Do saal baad: kya check ho sakta hai, kya nahi

Do saal se zyada beet chuke hain, lekin is article ke liye yeh verify nahi ho saka ki states ne bina kisi aur kaam wale officers appoint kiye, quarterly reports publish ki, aur special units banayi ya nahi.

National data bhi isse tay nahi kar sakta. 2024 mein police ne child marriage ke 1,499 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]], jo 2023 ke 6,038 se kam hain, jab akele Assam ke 5,267 cases the [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. Aise utaar-chadhaav enforcement dikhate hain, yeh nahi ki kitni shaadiyan hui, aur judgment tab aaya jab 2024 ke sirf lagbhag das hafte bache the. 2024 mein courts ne is Act ke tahat 209 convictions aur 625 acquittals diye, aur saal ke end tak 8,553 cases ab bhi pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sabse naye survey, NFHS-6, ne paaya ki 20-24 saal ki 20.1% women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui, lekin uska fieldwork 31 December 2024 ko khatam hua, aur woh saalon pehle ki shaadiyan record karta hai [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

Toh bachta hai woh ek record jise court ne public checking ke liye banaya: quarterly report. Agar guidelines maani ja rahi hain, toh yeh reports district-by-district official websites pe maujood hain. Koi bhi reader inhe dhoondh sakta hai. Agar yeh gayab hain, toh woh bhi ek jawaab hai.

she-said-yes-looked-older-myth.en:
Consider a 24-year-old man who meets a 16-year-old girl on Instagram. She likes his posts first. Within weeks they are chatting every night. He tells her she is more mature than girls her age, and that they must keep it secret because "people won't understand". When it turns sexual, he tells himself what many adults tell themselves, and what their families often say later: she agreed, she looked older, she started it. In Indian law, none of these is a defence.

The excuses come up because of who the accused usually are. In 2024 the largest group of accused in POCSO penetrative-assault cases, 22,308 of 44,126 (50.6%), were recorded as friends, online friends or live-in partners "on pretext of marriage" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. And 23,497 of the 44,567 victims, or 52.7%, were aged 16 to 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: the teenagers an adult can most easily tell himself are old enough. These tables do not give the age of the accused, and the category also takes in relationships between teenagers. This piece is about the adults. It is general information, not legal advice.

## The myth: if she agreed, it is not a crime

Between adults, consent is the line between sex and rape. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) defines it as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. So it sounds reasonable to many adults that a teenager's clear "yes" should count the same way. Families repeat it when a case is filed: she went willingly, she loved him, they were going to marry.

The myth survives because it borrows the language of respect. It treats a 16-year-old's word as if it settles the question. Below 18, the law has decided that it does not.

## The law: no 'yes' under 18

Section 63 of the BNS lists the circumstances in which sex is rape. One of them is sex with a girl under 18, "with or without her consent" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The POCSO Act calls everyone under 18 a child and protects boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], so a teenage boy's "yes" counts for no more than a teenage girl's.

There is no lower age at which a "yes" starts to count. Until 2013 the rape law's age of consent was 16; the criminal law amendment that year raised it to 18 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Marriage does not change this: the BNS exception for husbands covers only a wife who is 18 or older [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The penalties are heavy. Penetrative sexual assault on a child carries at least 10 years, and at least 20 if the child is under 16 [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## 'She looked older', 'she sent the first message': excuses that fail

**"She looked 18."** The BNS clause turns on one fact: how old she was. It says nothing about how old she looked, what her profile claimed or what he believed. In a POCSO trial, the Special Court starts by presuming that the accused committed the offence unless the contrary is proved [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. An adult who is not sure of someone's age has one safe choice, which is to stop.

**"She messaged first."** Who made the first move does not matter in law. Teenagers try out flirting; that is part of growing up. Acting on it is the adult's choice and the adult's responsibility.

**"She sent the photo herself."** A picture does not make the adult safer. Creating, browsing or downloading sexually explicit material depicting a child is punishable with up to 5 years on first conviction under the IT Act [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. In 2024 the Supreme Court held that storing or possessing such material is itself a POCSO offence when the circumstances show the intent the law specifies, even if it is never shared [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]].

**"She's mature for her age."** Maturity is not a legal category. Being under 18 is [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Grooming dressed up as romance

A "she said yes" case can be the end of a process, not the start of a romance. The child-protection nonprofit Darkness to Light describes grooming as a deliberate process by which offenders gradually build and keep a secret sexual relationship with a child. Its red flags include special attention to one child, gifts, acting as a sympathetic listener, offering to help the family and gaining access through the internet [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. UNICEF warns that online abusers often first win the trust of a child or a caregiver before manipulating the child into sharing sexual images [[unicef-keeping-children-safe-online-2026]].

Put the Instagram example next to that list. The flattery, the secrecy and the late-night chats are not signs of a relationship between equals. They are how a "yes" gets built, which is exactly why the law refuses to weigh it.

## What an adult must do instead

If a teenager flirts with you, messages you or says she likes you, you are the adult in the conversation. Say no plainly and keep it that way. Do not move to private chats, ask for photos, arrange to meet alone or agree to keep secrets. Teachers, coaches, tutors and relatives carry this duty most of all, because trust is what gives them access.

If you know of an adult in a sexual relationship with someone under 18, the law does not let you look away. Anyone who knows of a sexual offence against a child must report it to the police, and failing to do so can mean up to 6 months in prison or a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. You can call 1098, the 24x7 Child Helpline, which is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Families who defend the adult by blaming the girl, or try to settle the case with a wedding, change nothing in law. The excuses only decide who is made to carry the shame. The law has already decided who carries the responsibility.
she-said-yes-looked-older-myth.hg:
Socho, ek 24 saal ka aadmi Instagram par ek 16 saal ki ladki se milta hai. Pehle ladki uske posts like karti hai. Kuch hi hafton mein dono har raat chat karne lagte hain. Woh use kehta hai ki woh apni umar ki ladkiyon se zyada mature hai, aur yeh baat secret rakhni hogi kyunki "log nahi samjhenge". Jab baat sexual ho jaati hai, toh woh khud se wahi kehta hai jo bahut se adults kehte hain, aur jo baad mein unki families bhi kehti hain: usne haan kaha tha, woh badi lagti thi, shuruaat usne ki thi. Indian law mein inmein se koi bhi baat bachaav nahi hai.

Yeh bahane baar-baar isliye aate hain kyunki accused aksar kaun hote hain. 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault cases mein accused ka sabse bada group, 44,126 mein se 22,308 (50.6%), "friends, online friends ya shaadi ke bahane wale live-in partners" ke roop mein darj hua [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aur 44,567 victims mein se 23,497, yaani 52.7%, 16 se 18 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: wahi teenagers jinke baare mein ek adult sabse aasaani se khud ko samjha leta hai ki "yeh toh badi ho gayi hai". Yeh tables accused ki umar nahi batate, aur is category mein teenagers ke aapsi relationships bhi shaamil hain. Yeh article adults ke baare mein hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Myth: agar usne haan kaha, toh jurm nahi

Do adults ke beech consent hi sex aur rape ke beech ki line hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) consent ko "unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehta hai, yaani saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi sahmati [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Isliye kai adults ko yeh theek lagta hai ki teenager ki saaf "haan" bhi waise hi ginni chahiye. Case darj hone par families yahi dohraati hain: woh apni marzi se gayi thi, woh use pyaar karti thi, dono shaadi karne wale the.

Yeh myth isliye zinda hai kyunki yeh izzat ki bhasha udhaar le leta hai. Yeh 16 saal ki ladki ki baat ko aise pesh karta hai jaise usse sawaal hi khatam ho jaata ho. 18 se kam umar mein kanoon tay kar chuka hai ki aisa nahi hai.

## Kanoon: 18 se kam umar mein koi 'haan' nahi

BNS ka Section 63 un haalaat ki list deta hai jinmein sex rape hai. Inmein se ek hai 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex, "with or without her consent", yaani uski marzi ho ya na ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. POCSO Act 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko bachcha maanta hai aur ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ko barabar protect karta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Isliye teenage ladke ki "haan" bhi utni hi nahi ginti jitni teenage ladki ki.

Aisi koi kam umar nahi hai jahan se "haan" ginni shuru ho jaaye. 2013 tak rape law mein age of consent 16 thi; us saal ke criminal law amendment ne ise 18 kar diya [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Shaadi se bhi yeh nahi badalta: BNS mein husbands wala exception sirf us wife par laagu hota hai jo 18 ya usse badi ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Sazaayein bhaari hain. Bachche ke saath penetrative sexual assault ki saza kam se kam 10 saal hai, aur agar bachcha 16 se kam ho toh kam se kam 20 saal [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## 'Woh badi lagti thi', 'pehla message usne bheja': bahane jo fail hote hain

**"Woh 18 ki lagti thi."** BNS ka clause ek hi baat par tika hai: uski umar kya thi. Usme kahin nahi likha ki woh kitni badi dikhti thi, uski profile mein kya likha tha, ya aadmi kya samajh raha tha. POCSO trial mein Special Court yeh maan kar shuru karta hai ki accused ne offence kiya hai, jab tak ulta saabit na ho [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Jis adult ko kisi ki umar ka pakka pata nahi, uske paas ek hi safe raasta hai: ruk jaana.

**"Pehla message usne bheja tha."** Kanoon mein yeh matter nahi karta ki pehla kadam kisne uthaya. Teenagers flirting aazmate hain; yeh bade hone ka hissa hai. Us par aage badhna adult ka faisla hai, aur zimmedari bhi adult ki hai.

**"Photo usne khud bheji thi."** Photo se adult safe nahi ho jaata. IT Act ke tahat bachche ko dikhane wala sexually explicit material banana, browse karna ya download karna pehli conviction par 5 saal tak ki jail dila sakta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. 2024 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki aisa material store karna ya apne paas rakhna khud ek POCSO offence hai, jab haalaat se woh intent dikhe jo kanoon batata hai, chahe use kabhi share na kiya gaya ho [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]].

**"Woh apni umar se zyada mature hai."** Maturity koi legal category nahi hai. 18 se kam umar hona hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Romance ke kapdon mein grooming

"Usne haan kaha" wala case ek process ka ant ho sakta hai, kisi romance ki shuruaat nahi. Child protection par kaam karne wali nonprofit Darkness to Light grooming ko ek soch-samajh kar chalaya gaya process batati hai, jisme offender dheere-dheere bachche ke saath ek secret sexual rishta banata hai aur use banaye rakhta hai. Uske red flags mein shaamil hain: kisi ek bachche par khaas dhyaan, gifts, hamdard sunne wala ban jaana, family ki madad ki peshkash, aur internet ke zariye pahunch banana [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. UNICEF warning deta hai ki online abusers aksar pehle bachche ya uske caregiver ka bharosa jeetate hain, phir bachche ko sexual images share karne ke liye manipulate karte hain [[unicef-keeping-children-safe-online-2026]].

Ab Instagram wali kahani ko is list ke saath rakh kar dekho. Tareefein, raaz aur der raat tak chalti chats barabari ke rishte ki nishaani nahi hain. Inhi se ek "haan" banayi jaati hai, aur isi wajah se kanoon us "haan" ko taulne se mana karta hai.

## Adult ko iske bajaye kya karna chahiye

Agar koi teenager tumse flirt kare, tumhe message kare ya kahe ki tum use pasand ho, toh is baatcheet mein adult tum ho. Saaf mana karo aur usi par tike raho. Private chats par mat jao, photos mat maango, akele milne ka plan mat banao, aur koi secret rakhne ka vaada mat karo. Teachers, coaches, tutors aur rishtedaaron par yeh zimmedari sabse zyada hai, kyunki bharosa hi unhe bachchon tak pahunch deta hai.

Agar tumhe pata hai ki koi adult 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ke saath sexual relationship mein hai, toh kanoon tumhe nazar pherne nahi deta. Jise bhi kisi bachche ke saath sexual offence ki jaankari ho, use police ko report karna hoga, aur aisa na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail ya fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Tum 1098 par call kar sakte ho, jo 24x7 Child Helpline hai aur 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Jo families ladki ko dosh dekar adult ko bachaati hain, ya shaadi karwa kar case "settle" karna chahti hain, woh kanoon mein kuch nahi badaltin. Bahane sirf yeh tay karte hain ki sharm ka bojh kis par daala jaaye. Zimmedari kiski hai, yeh kanoon pehle hi tay kar chuka hai.

teen-relationships-pocso-law-questions.en:
Imagine two 17-year-olds in Jaipur who have been together for a year. They assume the law on sexual offences is about adults who hurt children, not about them. Many teenagers assume the same. But in 2013 Parliament raised the age of consent from 16 to 18 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]], and below 18 the law does not ask who agreed. This touches a lot of young lives: 52.7% of the child victims in POCSO penetrative-assault cases registered in 2024 were aged 16 to 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], though the police data does not say how many of those cases began as relationships. Here are five common questions, answered plainly. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Is a relationship under 18 illegal?

No law makes it a crime to like someone, to text, to go out or to call each other boyfriend and girlfriend. What the law controls is sexual activity. The POCSO Act, in force since 14 November 2012, treats anyone under 18 as a child, boy or girl [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) says sex with a girl under 18 is rape, "with or without her consent" [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

It is not only about intercourse. In 2021 the Supreme Court held that the key ingredient of sexual assault under POCSO is sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact [[barandbench-satish-2021]], so sexual touching can be an offence too. Sexually explicit photos or videos of anyone under 18 count as child sexual abuse material. Creating, collecting or exchanging them is punishable under Section 67B of the IT Act [[indiacode-it-act-2000]], and there is no exception for couples.

## What if we are both under 18?

The law has no exception for partners of the same or a similar age. You are both children in law, and neither of you can give legal consent. Being the same age protects neither of you from a case.

POCSO protects boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The rape law in the BNS is narrower: only a man can commit rape under it, and only a woman can be its victim [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If an accused is under 18, the case goes to a Juvenile Justice Board, not an ordinary criminal court.

A case usually starts with a report, and many adults around you are bound to make one. Under Sections 19 and 21 of POCSO, anyone who knows of a sexual offence against a child must tell the police, and failing to do so can mean up to 6 months in prison or a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. That includes parents, teachers and doctors.

## What happens if a family goes to the police?

Telling the police that you both agreed does not close the case; below 18, that is no defence. The child victim's statement must be recorded at home or at a place of their choice, by a woman officer where practicable, never in uniform, and the child must never be brought face to face with the accused [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

If the accused is an adult, even an 18- or 19-year-old, he is tried in a POCSO Special Court. Penetrative sexual assault carries at least 10 years in prison, and at least 20 if the child is under 16 [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The court must presume that the accused committed the offence unless the contrary is proved [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

A pregnancy brings in a doctor, who must also report. In 2022 the Supreme Court noted that this leaves a pregnant minor and her guardian choosing between a registered doctor, with the risk of a criminal case, and an unqualified provider. It ruled that a doctor ending a minor's pregnancy need not put her name in the police report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Can a 17-year-old be tried as an adult?

Yes, in some cases. Under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, when a child aged 16 or above is accused of a "heinous offence", which the Act defines as one with a minimum punishment of seven years or more, the Juvenile Justice Board must make a preliminary assessment. It can then send the case to a Children's Court for trial as an adult [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. With its 10-year minimum, penetrative sexual assault under POCSO falls in that category.

Even then, the law bars a death sentence, or life imprisonment without the possibility of release, for a person who was a child at the time of the offence [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. A 15-year-old cannot be sent for trial as an adult at all; the board deals with the case itself.

## Does getting married change anything?

No. A marriage in which the girl is under 18 or the boy under 21 is a child marriage [[indiacode-pcma-2006]], and it does not make sex lawful. On 11 October 2017, in Independent Thought v. Union of India, the Supreme Court held that sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. The BNS now says the same: its marital exception covers only wives aged 18 or older [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Nor is a wedding a way out of a criminal case. The Supreme Court has ruled that courts must not suggest a compromise or a marriage between the accused and the survivor [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]]. An adult man who marries a girl under 18, and anyone who performs or promotes a child marriage, faces up to two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. A person who was married as a child can have the marriage annulled: it is voidable at their option, by a petition in the district court within two years of turning 18 [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

None of this is meant to make teenagers afraid of their own feelings. It is meant to make sure nobody learns the law for the first time at a police station. If anyone, of any age, is pressuring you, call 1098.
teen-relationships-pocso-law-questions.hg:
Socho, Jaipur mein do 17 saal ke teenagers ek saal se saath hain. Unhe lagta hai ki sexual offences ka kanoon un adults ke liye hai jo bachchon ko nuksaan pahunchate hain, unke liye nahi. Bahut se teenagers yahi sochte hain. Lekin 2013 mein Parliament ne age of consent 16 se badha kar 18 kar di [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]], aur 18 se kam umar mein kanoon yeh nahi poochta ki kaun raazi tha. Yeh bahut saari zindagiyon ko chhoota hai: 2024 mein register hue POCSO penetrative assault cases ke 52.7% child victims 16 se 18 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]], halaanki police data yeh nahi batata ki inmein se kitne cases rishton se shuru hue. Yahan paanch aam sawaal hain, seedhe jawaabon ke saath. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya 18 se pehle relationship illegal hai?

Kisi ko pasand karna, text karna, saath bahar jaana ya ek-doosre ko boyfriend-girlfriend kehna kisi kanoon mein jurm nahi hai. Kanoon sexual activity ko control karta hai. 14 November 2012 se laagu POCSO Act 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, ladka ho ya ladki [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) kehti hai ki 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex rape hai, "with or without her consent", yaani uski marzi ho ya na ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Baat sirf intercourse ki nahi hai. 2021 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki POCSO mein sexual assault ka asli hissa sexual intent hai, skin-to-skin contact nahi [[barandbench-satish-2021]], isliye sexual touching bhi jurm ho sakti hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki bhi sexually explicit photos ya videos child sexual abuse material maani jaati hain. Inhe banana, jama karna ya share karna IT Act ke Section 67B ke tahat saza ke layak hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]], aur couples ke liye koi chhoot nahi hai.

## Agar hum dono 18 se kam hain toh?

Kanoon ek jaisi ya milti-julti umar ke partners ko koi chhoot nahi deta. Kanoon ki nazar mein tum dono children ho, aur tum mein se koi bhi kanooni consent nahi de sakta. Ek hi umar ka hona tum dono mein se kisi ko bhi case se nahi bachata.

POCSO ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ko ek jaisi suraksha deta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. BNS ke rape kanoon ka daayra chhota hai: iske tahat rape sirf ek mard kar sakta hai, aur victim sirf ek aurat ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agar accused 18 se kam hai, toh case aam criminal court mein nahi, Juvenile Justice Board ke paas jaata hai.

Case aksar ek report se shuru hota hai, aur tumhare aas-paas ke kai bade report karne ke liye bandhe hue hain. POCSO ke Sections 19 aur 21 ke tahat jis kisi ko bhi kisi bachche ke khilaaf sexual offence ka pata ho, use police ko batana hoga, aur na batane par 6 mahine tak ki jail ya fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Ismein mummy-papa, teachers aur doctors sab aate hain.

## Agar family police ke paas jaaye toh kya hota hai?

Police ko yeh kehne se case band nahi hota ki tum dono raazi the; 18 se kam umar mein yeh koi defence nahi hai. Child victim ka statement ghar par ya uski chuni hui jagah par record hona chahiye, jahan tak ho sake woman officer se, uniform ke bina, aur bachche ko kabhi accused ke aamne-saamne nahi laaya ja sakta [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Agar accused adult hai, chahe 18 ya 19 saal ka hi kyun na ho, toh uska trial POCSO Special Court mein hota hai. Penetrative sexual assault ki saza kam se kam 10 saal ki jail hai, aur agar bachcha 16 se kam ho toh kam se kam 20 saal [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Court ko yeh maan kar chalna hota hai ki accused ne offence kiya hai, jab tak iske ulta saabit na ho [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Pregnancy hone par doctor bhi beech mein aata hai, aur use bhi report karna hota hai. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne maana ki isse pregnant minor aur uske guardian ke saamne do hi raaste bachte hain: criminal case ke risk ke saath registered doctor, ya koi unqualified insaan. Court ne faisla diya ki minor ki pregnancy khatam karne wale doctor ko police report mein uska naam likhna zaroori nahi, agar woh aur uske guardian aisa maangein [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Kya 17 saal ke kisi par adult ki tarah case chal sakta hai?

Haan, kuch cases mein. Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 ke tahat jab 16 ya usse zyada umar ke kisi bachche par "heinous offence" ka aarop ho, yaani Act ke hisaab se aisa jurm jiski kam se kam saza saat saal ya usse zyada ho, toh Juvenile Justice Board ko ek preliminary assessment karna hota hai. Phir Board case ko adult ki tarah trial ke liye Children's Court bhej sakta hai [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. Kam se kam 10 saal ki saza ki wajah se POCSO ka penetrative sexual assault isi category mein aata hai.

Tab bhi kanoon us insaan ko maut ki saza, ya release ki sambhavna ke bina umar qaid, dene se rokta hai jo offence ke waqt child tha [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. 15 saal ke kisi par adult ki tarah trial bilkul nahi ho sakta; uska case Board khud dekhta hai.

## Kya shaadi karne se kuch badalta hai?

Nahi. Jis shaadi mein ladki 18 se kam ya ladka 21 se kam ho, woh child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]], aur usse sex kanooni nahi ho jaata. 11 October 2017 ko Independent Thought v. Union of India case mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. BNS bhi ab yahi kehti hai: uska marital exception sirf 18 ya usse zyada umar ki patniyon par laagu hota hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Shaadi criminal case se nikalne ka raasta bhi nahi hai. Supreme Court ne faisla diya hai ki courts accused aur survivor ke beech samjhaute ya shaadi ka sujhaav nahi de sakte [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]]. 18 se kam umar ki ladki se shaadi karne wale adult mard ko, aur child marriage karwane ya use badhaava dene wale kisi bhi insaan ko, do saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment (kathor jail) aur Rs 1 lakh tak ka fine ho sakta hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Jiski shaadi bachpan mein hui, use yeh shaadi annul, yaani radd, karwane ka haq hai: aisi shaadi uski marzi par voidable hai, aur 18 saal hone ke do saal ke andar district court mein petition daal kar use khatam karwaya ja sakta hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

Iska maqsad teenagers ko unki apni feelings se daraana nahi hai. Maqsad yeh hai ki kisi ko kanoon ka pata pehli baar police station mein na chale. Agar koi bhi, kisi bhi umar ka, tum par dabaav daal raha hai, toh 1098 par call karo.

trafficked-children-mostly-boys-2024.en:
In 2024, the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) counted 6,018 people as trafficked in India. Of them, 2,297, or 38%, were children under 18, and most of those children were boys: 1,384 boys against 913 girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That cuts against the common picture of child trafficking as something done only to girls. A second problem is quieter: the national tables that count these children do not say what any of them were trafficked for.

## 2,297 children, 1,384 of them boys

Boys were six in every ten trafficked children on record. Among adults, the pattern reverses: most trafficked adults on record were women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The boy majority is real in the data. What it means is harder to say.

The figures cover only cases reported by states' Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs): 2,135 trafficking cases in 2024, down 2.2% from 2,183 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Trafficking is often booked under other laws, such as kidnapping, child labour or the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, so this count is a floor. The boy majority may say as much about which cases police file as trafficking as about who is trafficked. Boys are also a tiny share of the victims in India's police records of child sexual abuse [[ncrb-cii-2024]], a gap we examine separately.

## Bihar and Rajasthan: where the trafficked boys were recorded

Two states account for almost half of the boys: Bihar recorded 410 trafficked boys in 2024, and Rajasthan 271 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. But the table lists victims by the state that reported them, not where a boy was born, taken from or found. A boy counted in Rajasthan may have been brought there from another state; a boy from Bihar may have been rescued, and counted, somewhere else.

Consider a hypothetical, but familiar, case. A 13-year-old boy's family is struggling. A man they know offers him work in a faraway city, with money sent home every month. The boy wants to help, so he goes. At the other end there are long hours, no pay and no way home. Trafficking does not need a kidnapping; it can begin with a promise like this. If he is ever rescued, his case may be filed as trafficking, as child labour, or not at all. Only the first lands in this table.

## Labour, sex, servitude, marriage: purposes not split by age

NCRB records why people were trafficked only for all rescued victims together. Of 5,839 victims rescued in 2024, 2,347 (40%) had been trafficked for sexual exploitation for prostitution, 1,493 (26%) for forced labour, 105 for domestic servitude and 98 for forced marriage [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Another 1,771, about three in ten, were recorded only under "other reasons" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The rescued count includes victims from earlier years' cases, so it does not match the 6,018 counted for 2024.

None of these purposes is split by age or sex. So nobody can say from the national tables how many of the 1,384 boys were made to work, how many were sexually exploited, or how many of the 913 girls were trafficked into marriage. A boy forced into a workshop and a girl sold for sex need different rescue, shelters, counselling and prosecutions. Planners who cannot see which children face which harm plan blind.

Sexual exploitation is not only a risk for girls, and the law protects every trafficked child. Words matter too: the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes replaces "child prostitute" with "child who has been trafficked" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. The crime belongs to the adults.

## What the BNS says about trafficking a child

Since 1 July 2024, trafficking is punished under Section 143 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS): 7 to 10 years' rigorous imprisonment for trafficking any person, at least 10 years and up to life for trafficking a child, and at least 14 years and up to life for trafficking more than one child [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If a police officer or public servant is involved, it is imprisonment for the rest of their natural life. The victim's consent is immaterial [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A boy who "agreed" to go is still a trafficked child.

Section 144 reaches beyond the people who move children: anyone who knowingly sexually exploits a trafficked child faces 5 to 10 years [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Under Section 199, a police officer who fails to record a trafficking complaint faces six months to two years [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

On paper, the law is severe. In court, it rarely bites. In 2024, trials were completed in 586 trafficking cases, and only 43 ended in a conviction, a conviction rate of 7.3% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. More than nine in ten ended in acquittal or discharge. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Missing children and the data India still lacks

Trafficking does not always enter police records as trafficking. In the same year, 98,375 children were reported missing, 75,603 of them girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Here the skew runs the other way: girls are more than three in four missing children, boys six in ten trafficked children. Neither table says how many children appear in both. A child's label seems to depend on how, where and by whom the child is found, not only on what was done to them. Our by-the-numbers look at crimes against children in 2024 sets both counts in the wider picture.

India has built machinery to see more: by March 2025, the Nirbhaya Fund had paid for 827 Anti-Human Trafficking Units [[pib-wcd-nirbhaya-fund-2025]]. Yet the national data on their work stays thin. Better data is easy to describe: purpose split by age and sex; where each child was taken from and found; and links from each case to any earlier missing-child report, to what happened after rescue, and to any conviction.

Until then, the 1,384 boys and 913 girls remain numbers without a story. If you suspect a child is being trafficked, taken away for work, kept out of school or moved by adults who cannot explain why, call the Child Helpline 1098, which is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
trafficked-children-mostly-boys-2024.hg:
2024 mein National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ne India mein 6,018 logon ko trafficking ka shikaar darj kiya. Inmein se 2,297, yaani 38%, 18 saal se kam umar ke bachche the, aur in bachchon mein zyadatar ladke the: 1,384 ladke aur 913 ladkiyan [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh us aam tasveer ko todta hai jismein child trafficking ko sirf ladkiyon ke saath hone wali cheez maana jaata hai. Doosri problem zyada khamosh hai: jo national tables in bachchon ko ginti hain, woh yeh nahi bataati ki inmein se kisi bhi bachche ko kis kaam ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha.

## 2,297 bachche, jinmein 1,384 ladke

Record mein darj har das trafficked bachchon mein se chhe ladke the. Adults mein tasveer ulti ho jaati hai: record mein darj zyadatar trafficked adults auratein thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Data mein ladkon ki majority asli hai. Iska matlab kya hai, yeh kehna zyada mushkil hai.

Yeh aankde sirf un cases ke hain jo states ki Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs) ne report kiye: 2024 mein trafficking ke 2,135 cases, jo 2023 ke 2,183 se 2.2% kam the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Trafficking aksar doosre kanoonon mein darj hoti hai, jaise kidnapping, child labour ya Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, isliye yeh ginti sirf nichli seema hai, poori tasveer nahi. Ladkon ki majority shayad utna hi is baare mein batati hai ki police kaunse cases trafficking ke naam se file karti hai, jitna is baare mein ki traffic kaun hota hai. India ke police records mein child sexual abuse ke victims mein bhi ladkon ka hissa bahut chhota hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]; us gap par hum alag se baat karte hain.

## Bihar aur Rajasthan: jahan trafficked ladke darj hue

Lagbhag aadhe ladke sirf do states mein darj hue: 2024 mein Bihar ne 410 trafficked ladke darj kiye, aur Rajasthan ne 271 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Lekin table victims ko us state ke hisaab se ginti hai jisne unhe report kiya, is hisaab se nahi ki ladka kahan paida hua, kahan se le jaaya gaya ya kahan mila. Rajasthan mein gina gaya ladka kisi doosre state se wahan laaya gaya ho sakta hai; Bihar ka koi ladka kahin aur rescue hua ho, aur wahin gina gaya ho.

Ek hypothetical, lekin jaana-pehchaana, case sochiye. 13 saal ke ek ladke ka parivaar mushkil mein hai. Unka ek jaan-pehchaan wala aadmi use door ke kisi shehar mein kaam dilaane ki offer deta hai, aur kehta hai ki har mahine paise ghar aayenge. Ladka ghar ki madad karna chahta hai, isliye chala jaata hai. Wahan pahunchkar lambe ghante hain, koi tankhwah nahi, aur ghar lautne ka koi raasta nahi. Trafficking ke liye kidnapping zaroori nahi; yeh aise hi kisi vaade se shuru ho sakti hai. Agar use kabhi rescue kiya gaya, toh uska case trafficking mein file ho sakta hai, child labour mein, ya bilkul nahi. Sirf pehli soorat mein hi woh is table tak pahunchta hai.

## Mazdoori, sex, gharelu gulami, shaadi: maqsad umar ke hisaab se alag nahi

Logon ko kis maqsad se traffic kiya gaya, yeh NCRB sirf saare rescued victims ko ek saath milakar darj karta hai. 2024 mein rescue kiye gaye 5,839 victims mein se 2,347 (40%) ko prostitution ke liye sexual exploitation ke maqsad se traffic kiya gaya tha, 1,493 (26%) ko forced labour ke liye, 105 ko gharelu gulami (domestic servitude) ke liye aur 98 ko zabardasti shaadi ke liye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Baaki 1,771, yaani lagbhag das mein se teen, sirf "other reasons" mein darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Rescue wali ginti mein pichhle saalon ke cases ke victims bhi shaamil hain, isliye yeh 2024 ke 6,018 se match nahi karti.

Inmein se koi bhi maqsad umar ya sex ke hisaab se alag nahi kiya gaya. Isliye national tables se koi nahi bata sakta ki 1,384 ladkon mein se kitnon se kaam karwaya gaya, kitnon ka sexual exploitation hua, ya 913 ladkiyon mein se kitni ko shaadi ke liye traffic kiya gaya. Kisi workshop mein zabardasti kaam par lagaye gaye ladke aur sex ke liye bechi gayi ladki ko alag tarah ka rescue, alag shelter, alag counselling aur alag prosecution chahiye. Jo planners yeh nahi dekh sakte ki kis bachche ko kaunsa nuksaan ho raha hai, woh andhere mein plan banate hain.

Sexual exploitation ka khatra sirf ladkiyon ke liye nahi hai, aur kanoon har trafficked bachche ko bachata hai. Shabd bhi maayne rakhte hain: gender stereotypes par Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook "child prostitute" ki jagah "child who has been trafficked", yaani "aisa bachcha jise traffic kiya gaya", kehne ko kehti hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Crime adults ka hai, bachche ka nahi.

## Bachche ki trafficking par BNS kya kehta hai

1 July 2024 se trafficking ki saza Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 143 ke tahat milti hai: kisi bhi insaan ki trafficking par 7 se 10 saal ki kathor kaid, ek bachche ki trafficking par kam se kam 10 saal aur umrqaid tak, aur ek se zyada bachchon ki trafficking par kam se kam 14 saal aur umrqaid tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agar koi police officer ya public servant shaamil ho, toh saza baaki poori zindagi ki kaid hai. Victim ki consent ka koi matlab nahi [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Jo ladka jaane ke liye "maan gaya" tha, woh bhi trafficked bachcha hi hai.

Section 144 un logon se aage bhi jaata hai jo bachchon ko ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaate hain: jo bhi jaante-boojhte kisi trafficked bachche ka sexual exploitation karta hai, use 5 se 10 saal ki saza ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Section 199 ke tahat, jo police officer trafficking ki complaint darj nahi karta, use chhe mahine se do saal tak ki saza ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Kaagaz par kanoon sakht hai. Court mein iska asar kam hi dikhta hai. 2024 mein trafficking ke 586 cases ke trial poore hue, aur sirf 43 mein conviction hua, yaani conviction rate 7.3% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Das mein se nau se zyada cases acquittal ya discharge par khatam hue. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

## Laapata bachche, aur woh data jo India ke paas ab bhi nahi

Trafficking hamesha police records mein trafficking ke naam se nahi pahunchti. Usi saal 98,375 bachchon ke laapata hone ki report darj hui, jinmein 75,603 ladkiyan thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yahan jhukaav ulta hai: laapata bachchon mein chaar mein se teen se zyada ladkiyan hain, jabki trafficked bachchon mein das mein se chhe ladke. Koi bhi table yeh nahi batati ki kitne bachche dono mein aate hain. Lagta hai ki bachche par kaunsa label lagega, yeh is par bhi nirbhar karta hai ki woh kaise, kahan aur kisko mila, sirf is par nahi ki uske saath kya hua. 2024 mein bachchon ke khilaaf crimes par hamari by-the-numbers story dono ginti ko badi tasveer mein rakhti hai.

India ne zyada dekhne ke liye machinery banayi hai: March 2025 tak Nirbhaya Fund se 827 Anti-Human Trafficking Units ka kharcha diya gaya tha [[pib-wcd-nirbhaya-fund-2025]]. Phir bhi unke kaam par national data bahut kam hai. Behtar data kaisa ho, yeh batana aasaan hai: maqsad ko umar aur sex ke hisaab se alag kiya jaaye; har bachcha kahan se le jaaya gaya aur kahan mila, yeh darj ho; aur har case ko pehle ki kisi missing-child report se, rescue ke baad kya hua usse, aur kisi conviction se joda jaaye.

Tab tak 1,384 ladke aur 913 ladkiyan bina kahani ke numbers hi rahenge. Agar aapko shak hai ki kisi bachche ki trafficking ho rahi hai, use kaam ke liye le jaaya ja raha hai, school se door rakha ja raha hai, ya aise adults use kahin le ja rahe hain jo wajah nahi bata paate, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kariye, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

under-18-abused-what-you-can-do.en:
This is for you if you are under 18 and someone is doing something sexual to you that you did not want, or that you were told to keep secret. It might be a relative, a teacher, a coach, a neighbour or an older "boyfriend". If it is someone you know, you are not unusual: in 96.6% of the child-rape cases police registered under POCSO in 2024, the abuser was someone the child knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is part of why it is so hard to tell. In the government's 2007 study, 72.1% of sexually assaulted children had told no one [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

It is not your fault, even if you said yes, went with them or accepted gifts. POCSO treats everyone under 18 as a child, boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], and any sexual act with a child is an offence. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Can I report it myself, without my parents?

Yes. You do not need a parent's permission. Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) lets anyone report a crime like this at any police station, wherever it happened; this is called a Zero FIR. You can also report electronically, and then sign the complaint within 3 days. Either way, you get a copy of the FIR free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

If an officer refuses to write it down, that refusal is itself an offence under POCSO [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Adults will become involved once you report: police must inform the district's Child Welfare Committee and the Special Court within 24 hours [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. If the abuser lives with you, say so. And if a parent is the problem, the law lets another person you trust be with you in court instead [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Who do I call first: 1098, 112 or a police station?

- **112** if you are in danger right now [[mha-erss]].
- **1098**, the Child Helpline, if you want people who deal with child abuse. It works 24x7, is run with state and district child-protection staff and is linked to 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- **Any police station**, if you are ready to file a complaint.
- **1930 or cybercrime.gov.in** if photos, videos or threats are involved online [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

On the call, say your age, where you are, whether you are safe tonight and who did it. You do not need proof. What you say starts the case.

## What happens after I report, and what stays private?

Police must record your statement at your home or a place you choose, as far as practicable through a woman officer of sub-inspector rank or above, who must not be in uniform. They must make sure you never come into contact with the accused, and they cannot keep you at a police station at night for any reason [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The investigation must be completed within two months [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], and you are entitled to an update within 90 days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Your identity is protected. No media report may reveal your name, address, photo, family details, school or neighbourhood; doing so can mean 6 months to 1 year in prison, a fine, or both [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. FIRs in POCSO cases must not be put in the public domain [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. The trial is held in camera [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Lawyers' questions go through the judge, aggressive questioning is not allowed, you need not see the accused while you testify, and a parent or another person you trust can be present [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

The honest part is the wait. The court is meant to record your evidence within 30 days of taking up the case and finish the trial, as far as possible, within a year [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. But at the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were pending trial [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. You can also apply for victim compensation to the District Legal Services Authority, even if the abuser is never traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Can I see a doctor for free, and will they have to tell anyone?

Yes, and yes. Every hospital, government or private, must treat you immediately and free of cost, and must inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Doctors, teachers and counsellors are bound by POCSO's reporting rule, so they cannot promise to keep abuse secret. You, as a child, cannot be punished for not reporting [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

If it happened in the last few days, go now. Medicine that prevents HIV, called PEP, must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after, and is taken for 28 days [[who-pep]]. Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, sooner is better, and it is not an abortion [[who-ec]]. A medical examination to collect evidence is separate from treatment, and it needs consent [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ask what each step is for.

If you are pregnant and want an abortion, the doctor must still report it, but you and your guardian can ask that your name and personal details be left out of that report [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Not ready to report: where can I talk?

Not being ready is common. It does not make what happened less real.

Tele-MANAS, on 14416, is the Health Ministry's tele-mental-health service [[tele-manas]]. It is free and round-the-clock, and offers counselling to anyone in need, including transgender people [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. You can talk about panic, sleeplessness, anger, numbness or thoughts of hurting yourself without naming anyone. If you describe abuse in detail, a counsellor may have to report it like any other adult, so ask first how it works [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Meanwhile, keep evidence: screenshots, dates, names, anything the person sent you. Do not delete chats. And think of one adult you trust, an aunt, an older cousin, a teacher or a school counsellor, whom you could tell when you are ready. They will have to report, but they can stand next to you while it happens.

Boys are covered by every word of this. POCSO protects them as much as girls [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], and 892 boys were recorded as victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], a number that misses the many boys who never tell. Whatever you decide today, what happened is not your fault.
under-18-abused-what-you-can-do.hg:
Yeh tumhare liye hai, agar tumhari umar 18 se kam hai aur koi tumhare saath kuch sexual kar raha hai jo tum nahi chahte the, ya jise secret rakhne ko kaha gaya hai. Woh koi rishtedaar ho sakta hai, teacher, coach, padosi ya koi badi umar ka "boyfriend". Agar woh koi jaan-pehchaan wala hai, toh tum akele nahi ho: 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat police ne child rape ke jo cases darj kiye, unmein se 96.6% mein abuser bachche ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Batana itna mushkil hone ki ek badi wajah yahi hai. Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein, sexual assault jhel chuke 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai, chahe tumne haan kaha ho, unke saath gaye ho ya gifts liye hon. POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko bachcha maanta hai, ladke aur ladkiyan dono [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], aur bachche ke saath koi bhi sexual act jurm hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya parents ke bina khud report kiya ja sakta hai?

Haan. Iske liye parents ki permission nahi chahiye. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 173 kisi ko bhi aise crime ki report kisi bhi police station mein karne deta hai, chahe woh kahin bhi hua ho; ise Zero FIR kehte hain. Tum electronically bhi report kar sakte ho, aur phir 3 din ke andar complaint par sign karna hota hai. Dono tareekon mein FIR ki copy tumhe free milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Agar koi officer ise likhne se mana kare, toh yeh mana karna khud POCSO ke tahat jurm hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Report karne ke baad adults judenge: police ko 24 ghante ke andar district ki Child Welfare Committee aur Special Court ko batana hota hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Agar abuser tumhare saath rehta hai, toh yeh zaroor batao. Aur agar problem parent hi hain, toh kanoon court mein unki jagah kisi aur bharose ke insaan ko tumhare saath rehne deta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Pehle kise call karun: 1098, 112 ya police station?

- **112**, agar tum abhi khatre mein ho [[mha-erss]].
- **1098**, yaani Child Helpline, agar tum un logon se baat karna chahte ho jo child abuse ke cases sambhalte hain. Yeh 24x7 kaam karti hai, state aur district ke child-protection staff ke saath chalti hai, aur 112 se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- **Koi bhi police station**, agar tum complaint file karne ke liye taiyaar ho.
- **1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in**, agar online photos, videos ya dhamkiyan shaamil hain [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Call par batao ki tumhari umar kya hai, tum kahan ho, aaj raat tum safe ho ya nahi, aur yeh kisne kiya. Proof ki zaroorat nahi hai. Tum jo batate ho, wahi case ki shuruaat hai.

## Report ke baad kya hota hai, aur kya private rehta hai?

Police ko tumhara statement tumhare ghar par ya tumhari chuni hui jagah par record karna hota hai, jahan tak ho sake sub-inspector ya usse upar rank ki woman officer ke zariye, jo uniform mein na ho. Unhe pakka karna hota hai ki tumhara accused se kabhi aamna-saamna na ho, aur woh tumhe kisi bhi wajah se raat mein police station mein nahi rakh sakte [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Investigation do mahine ke andar poori honi chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], aur 90 din ke andar update milna tumhara haq hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Tumhari pehchaan kanoon se protected hai. Koi bhi media report tumhara naam, address, photo, family ki details, school ya mohalla nahi bata sakti; aisa karne par 6 mahine se 1 saal tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. POCSO cases ki FIRs public domain mein nahi daali ja saktin [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. Trial in camera, yaani band kamre mein hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Lawyers ke sawaal judge ke zariye poochhe jaate hain, aggressive sawaal-jawaab ki ijaazat nahi hai, gawahi dete waqt tumhe accused ko dekhna nahi padega, aur ek parent ya koi aur bharose ka insaan tumhare saath reh sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Imaandari wali baat yeh hai ki intezaar lamba hota hai. Court ko case haath mein lene ke 30 din ke andar tumhari gawahi record karni chahiye aur jahan tak ho sake ek saal mein trial khatam karna chahiye [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Lekin 2024 ke ant mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ke intezaar mein the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Tum District Legal Services Authority se victim compensation ke liye bhi apply kar sakte ho, chahe abuser kabhi pakda hi na jaaye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Kya doctor ko free mein dikhaya ja sakta hai, aur kya unhe kisi ko batana padega?

Haan, aur haan. Har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, tumhara ilaaj turant aur free mein karega, aur police ko khabar dega [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Doctors, teachers aur counsellors POCSO ke reporting rule se bandhe hain, isliye woh abuse ko secret rakhne ka vaada nahi kar sakte. Tum bachche ho, isliye report na karne par tumhe saza nahi ho sakti [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Agar yeh pichhle kuch dinon mein hua hai, toh abhi jao. HIV rokne wali dawai, jise PEP kehte hain, jitni jaldi ho sake aur 72 ghante ke andar hi shuru honi chahiye, aur yeh 28 din tak li jaati hai [[who-pep]]. Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karti hai, jitni jaldi utna behtar, aur yeh abortion nahi hai [[who-ec]]. Saboot jutane ke liye hone wala medical examination ilaaj se alag hai, aur uske liye consent zaroori hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Har step ka matlab poochho.

Agar tum pregnant ho aur abortion chahti ho, toh doctor ko phir bhi report karna hoga, lekin tum aur tumhare guardian maang sakte ho ki us report mein tumhara naam aur personal details na likhe jaayein [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Abhi report ke liye taiyaar nahi: baat kahan karun?

Taiyaar na hona aam baat hai. Isse jo hua, woh kam sach nahi ho jaata.

Tele-MANAS, 14416 par, Health Ministry ki tele-mental-health service hai [[tele-manas]]. Yeh free hai, din-raat chalti hai, aur har zaroorat-mand ko counselling deti hai, transgender logon ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Tum panic, neend na aana, gussa, sunn pad jaana, ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke khayalon ke baare mein kisi ka naam liye bina baat kar sakte ho. Agar tum abuse ke baare mein detail mein batate ho, toh counsellor ko bhi kisi aur adult ki tarah report karna pad sakta hai, isliye pehle pooch lo ki yeh kaise kaam karta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Tab tak saboot sambhalo: screenshots, dates, naam, us insaan ka bheja hua sab kuch. Chats delete mat karo. Aur ek aise adult ke baare mein socho jis par tumhe bharosa ho, jaise koi mausi ya bua, bada cousin, teacher ya school counsellor, jise tum taiyaar hone par bata sako. Unhe report karna padega, lekin jab yeh sab ho raha ho, tab woh tumhare saath khade reh sakte hain.

Ladkon par bhi yeh sab baatein poori tarah laagu hoti hain. POCSO unhe bhi utna hi protect karta hai jitna ladkiyon ko [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], aur 2024 mein 892 ladke penetrative sexual assault ke victims ke roop mein darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh number un bahut se ladkon ko nahi ginta jo kabhi kisi ko nahi batate. Aaj tum jo bhi tay karo, jo hua usme tumhari galti nahi hai.

warning-signs-child-sexual-abuse.en:
Imagine a seven-year-old in Indore, dry at night since she was four, who starts wetting the bed again, wakes up crying and hides in the bathroom on the evenings her home tutor comes. Her family scolds her for the bedwetting and the tantrums. Nobody connects the three. Abuse often stays hidden like this: not for lack of signs, but because no adult read them. In the government's 2007 Study on Child Abuse, 72.1% of sexually assaulted children had told no one, and only 3.4% had reported it to the police [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. When children do not tell, adults have to notice.

## Why injuries are rarely the clue

Many parents assume abuse would leave a mark, so they check the body and miss the behaviour. Darkness to Light, a US child-protection nonprofit, says direct physical signs of sexual abuse are not common; emotional and behavioural changes are the more common signs [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

The other reason is who abuses. The 2007 study found that half of abusers were people the child knew or people in a position of trust [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. In 96.6% of the penetrative sexual assault cases police registered under POCSO in 2024, the accused was someone the child knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. An adult with regular access can silence a child with attention, gifts, secrecy or fear, as our grooming explainer shows.

## Changes in sleep, body and mood

Darkness to Light's emotional and behavioural signs include anxiety and depression; nightmares, night terrors and other sleep problems; going back to outgrown behaviour, such as bedwetting or thumb-sucking; and changes in mood or in attitude to school [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Two more surprise parents: sexual behaviour or language beyond the child's age, and a child who becomes too "perfect" or overly compliant [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

The word that matters is change. A child who has always been shy is not showing a sign; a chatty child who goes quiet for weeks may be. Compare the child with their own self a few months ago, not with a cousin. Note when it began, and what else began then: a new tutor, a new van, a stay with relatives, a new phone. Watch boys as closely as girls: in the 2007 study, 52.94% of the children who reported sexual abuse were boys [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Worry and fear can also cause real stomach aches and headaches. See a doctor for the symptom, and keep watching the pattern.

## Changes around one person or one place

The sharpest sign on the list is also the easiest to brush aside: unusual fear of certain people or places, or reluctance to be alone with a certain person [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. In many Indian homes, a child who hides from a visiting uncle, won't touch a relative's feet or refuses to board the school van is scolded for being rude. Get curious instead. Is it one person, one place, one time of day? Does the dread start before a visit and lift after it?

Watch the adult too. Special attention to one child, gifts and offers to help the family are among Darkness to Light's red flags for grooming [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. A child's fear of one person, plus that person's special interest in the child, is a pattern worth acting on.

Never make a child hug, kiss or sit on the lap of any adult, relatives included. A child allowed to say no in front of you learns that their no counts.

## Online distress: the newer signs

Abuse no longer needs a room. UNICEF's common signs that something online has distressed a child include headaches or stomach aches, trouble sleeping, appetite changes, unexplained sadness or anxiety, distress after time online, avoiding devices or unusual secrecy about them, and fear of going to school [[unicef-parenting-negative-online-experience-2026]]. They signal distress, not necessarily sexual abuse. UNICEF also warns that online abusers, known to the child or strangers, often win the trust of a child or caregiver first, then manipulate the child into sharing sexual images or videos [[unicef-keeping-children-safe-online-2026]].

Watch the timing. A 14-year-old who goes silent after a late-night chat, jumps when the phone buzzes or begs to skip school may be carrying something they are ashamed to share. Don't snatch or ban the phone: if telling you means losing it, children may stop telling. Say instead: "Whatever happened on there, you are not in trouble with me."

## A sign is a question, not a verdict: how to ask

Every sign here has other causes: exams, bullying, a new sibling, illness, a fight at home. Darkness to Light cautions that the signs can be indistinguishable from other signs of stress, distress or trauma in a child [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. One sign is not proof or grounds to accuse anyone. It is a reason to ask, and keep asking.

- **Choose a calm, private moment,** side by side: on a walk, in the car, while cooking.
- **Start with what you noticed, not what you fear:** "You don't seem to want to go to tuition any more. What's it like there?"
- **Ask open questions** such as "What happened then?" Avoid questions that hand the child an answer, like "Did uncle touch you?" They can put words in a child's mouth.
- **Skip "why".** "Why didn't you tell me?" sounds like blame.
- **Leave the door open** if the child says nothing: "You can tell me anything, even if someone said it's a secret." Ask again another day.

Never promise secrecy; promise to keep the child safe. You need suspicion, not proof. Under Sections 19 and 21 of the POCSO Act, anyone who knows or suspects that a child is being sexually abused must report it to the police or the Special Juvenile Police Unit; not reporting can mean up to six months in prison, a fine or both [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. If a child tells you, believe them, don't probe for details, and call 1098 or 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Our POCSO reporting guide explains what happens next. This is general information, not legal advice.
warning-signs-child-sexual-abuse.hg:
Sochiye, Indore mein saat saal ki ek bachchi hai jo chaar saal ki umar se raat mein bistar geela nahi karti. Kuch hafton mein woh phir se bistar geela karne lagti hai, rote hue jaag jaati hai, aur jis shaam home tutor aata hai, us shaam bathroom mein chhup jaati hai. Ghar wale use bistar geela karne aur nakhron ke liye daant dete hain. Koi teeno baaton ko jodta nahi. Abuse aksar aise hi chhupa rehta hai: isliye nahi ki signs nahi the, balki isliye ki kisi adult ne unhe padha nahi. Sarkar ki 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein sexual assault jhelne wale 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha, aur sirf 3.4% ne police ko report kiya tha [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. Jab bachche nahi batate, toh adults ko khud notice karna padta hai.

## Chot shayad hi kabhi suraag hoti hai

Bahut se parents maan lete hain ki abuse koi nishaan chhodega, isliye woh body check karte hain aur behaviour miss kar dete hain. US ki child-protection nonprofit Darkness to Light kehti hai ki sexual abuse ke seedhe physical signs aam nahi hote; emotional aur behavioural badlaav zyada aam signs hain [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

Doosri wajah yeh hai ki abuse karta kaun hai. 2007 ki study mein nikla ki aadhe abusers aise log the jinhe bachcha jaanta tha, ya jo bharose ki position mein the [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat police ne penetrative sexual assault ke jo cases register kiye, unmein se 96.6% mein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jis adult ki bachche tak regular pahunch hai, woh attention, gifts, secrecy ya darr se bachche ko chup kara sakta hai, jaisa hamara grooming explainer dikhata hai.

## Neend, body aur mood mein badlaav

Darkness to Light ke emotional aur behavioural signs mein yeh shaamil hain: anxiety aur depression; bure sapne, night terrors aur neend ki doosri problems; chhoot chuki aadaton par laut jaana, jaise bistar geela karna ya angootha choosna; aur mood mein ya school ke prati ravaiye mein badlaav [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Do aur signs parents ko chaunka dete hain: bachche ki umar se aage ka sexual behaviour ya sexual bhasha, aur aisa bachcha jo zaroorat se zyada "perfect" ho jaaye ya har baat chupchaap maanne lage [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

Asli shabd hai badlaav. Jo bachcha hamesha se sharmila hai, woh koi sign nahi dikha raha; lekin jo baatooni bachcha hafton tak chup ho jaaye, woh shayad dikha raha ho. Bachche ki tulna kuch mahine pehle wale usi bachche se kariye, kisi cousin se nahi. Note kariye ki badlaav kab shuru hua, aur usi waqt aur kya shuru hua: naya tutor, nayi van, relatives ke ghar rukna, naya phone. Ladkon par bhi utni hi nazar rakhiye jitni ladkiyon par: 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Chinta aur darr se sach mein pet dard aur sir dard ho sakta hai. Symptom ke liye doctor ko dikhaiye, aur pattern par nazar rakhte rahiye.

## Kisi ek insaan ya ek jagah ke aas-paas badlaav

List ka sabse tez sign hi sabse aasaani se nazarandaaz hota hai: kuch logon ya jagahon se ajeeb darr, ya kisi khaas insaan ke saath akele rehne se katraana [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Kai Indian gharon mein jo bachcha ghar aaye kisi uncle se chhupta hai, kisi rishtedaar ke pair chhoone se mana karta hai, ya school van mein baithne se inkaar karta hai, use badtameez keh kar daanta jaata hai. Daantne ki jagah samajhne ki koshish kariye. Kya yeh ek hi insaan, ek hi jagah, din ka ek hi waqt hai? Kya ghabrahat kisi ke aane se pehle shuru hoti hai aur uske jaane ke baad khatam ho jaati hai?

Adult par bhi nazar rakhiye. Kisi ek bachche par special attention, gifts aur family ki madad ki offers, Darkness to Light ke grooming red flags mein se hain [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Bachche ka kisi ek insaan se darr, aur us insaan ka usi bachche mein khaas interest, yeh aisa pattern hai jis par kadam uthana chahiye.

Kisi bhi bachche ko kisi adult ko hug karne, kiss karne ya uski god mein baithne par majboor mat kariye, relatives ke saath bhi nahi. Jis bachche ko aapke saamne "na" kehne diya jaata hai, woh seekhta hai ki uski "na" maayne rakhti hai.

## Online distress: naye signs

Abuse ko ab kisi kamre ki zaroorat nahi. UNICEF ke hisaab se jab online kuch hone se bachcha pareshaan hota hai, toh aam signs mein yeh shaamil hain: sir dard ya pet dard, neend na aana, bhookh mein badlaav, bina wajah udaasi ya anxiety, online waqt bitane ke baad pareshaani, devices se bachna ya unke baare mein ajeeb secrecy, aur school jaane se darr [[unicef-parenting-negative-online-experience-2026]]. Yeh pareshaani ke signs hain, zaroori nahi ki sexual abuse ke hon. UNICEF yeh bhi aagah karta hai ki online abusers, chahe bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale hon ya ajnabi, aksar pehle bachche ya uske ghar walon ka bharosa jeette hain, phir bachche ko manipulate karke usse sexual images ya videos bhijwaate hain [[unicef-keeping-children-safe-online-2026]].

Timing par dhyaan dijiye.
