Agar koi 14 saal ka teenager raat ki kisi chat ke baad chup ho jaaye, phone bajne par chaunk jaaye ya school na jaane ki zid kare, toh ho sakta hai woh kuch aisa dil mein dabaye baitha ho jise batane mein use sharam aa rahi hai. Phone chheeniye mat, na hi us par ban lagaiye: agar batane ka matlab phone khona hai, toh bachche batana band kar sakte hain. Iski jagah kahiye: "Wahan jo bhi hua ho, mere saath tum kisi musibat mein nahi ho."

## Sign ek sawaal hai, faisla nahi: kaise poochein

Yahan diye har sign ki doosri wajahein bhi ho sakti hain: exams, bullying, naya bhai ya behan, beemari, ghar mein jhagda. Darkness to Light chetaavni deti hai ki yeh signs bachche mein stress, pareshaani ya trauma ke doosre signs jaise hi dikh sakte hain, aur inmein farq karna mushkil ho sakta hai [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Ek sign na sabut hai, na kisi par ilzaam lagane ki wajah. Yeh poochne ki wajah hai, aur baar-baar poochte rehne ki.

- **Shaant, private pal chuniye,** aamne-saamne nahi, saath-saath: walk par, gaadi mein, khana banate hue.
- **Jo dekha woh bataiye, jo darr hai woh nahi:** "Lagta hai tum ab tuition nahi jaana chahte. Wahan kaisa lagta hai?"
- **Open questions poochiye,** jaise "Phir kya hua?" Aise sawaal mat poochiye jo bachche ko jawab pakda dein, jaise "Kya uncle ne tumhe chhua?" Aise sawaal bachche ke munh mein shabd daal sakte hain.
- **"Kyun" chhod dijiye.** "Tumne mujhe bataya kyun nahi?" ilzaam jaisa lagta hai.
- **Darwaza khula rakhiye** agar bachcha kuch na bole: "Tum mujhe kuch bhi bata sakte ho, chahe kisi ne kaha ho ki yeh secret hai." Kisi aur din phir poochiye.

Secret rakhne ka vaada kabhi mat kariye; bachche ko surakshit rakhne ka vaada kariye. Sabut nahi, shak kaafi hai. POCSO Act ke Sections 19 aur 21 ke tahat, jo bhi jaanta hai ya jise shak hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, use police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko report karna hoga; report na karne par chhe mahine tak ki jail, jurmana ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Agar bachcha aapko bataye, toh us par bharosa kariye, details ke liye pooch-taachh mat kariye, aur 1098 ya 112 par call kariye [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Hamari POCSO reporting guide batati hai ki aage kya hota hai. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

who-is-a-child-indian-law.en:
A 17-year-old cannot legally agree to sex. A 20-year-old man is still a "child" if he gets married. A 16-year-old accused of a serious crime can be tried as an adult. All three are true in India at the same time, because each law draws the line of childhood at its own age. Here they are in one place, and why the mismatch matters. This is general information, not legal advice.

## 18: the line on sex and consent

For sexual offences the line is 18. The POCSO Act calls every person under 18 a child, boy or girl [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) lists, among the circumstances that make sex rape, "with or without her consent, when she is under eighteen years of age" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The BNS rape section protects only women and girls, so a boy's protection comes from POCSO.

The line has moved before. Until 2013 the rape law's line was 16; that year's criminal law amendment raised it to 18 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Marriage does not lower it. Since the Supreme Court's 2017 ruling in Independent Thought, sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. The BNS keeps that rule: its marital exception covers only a wife "not being under eighteen years of age" [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Inside childhood the law draws more lines. Raping a girl under 16 carries at least 20 years' rigorous imprisonment; raping a girl under 12 carries the same or death [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Anyone accused of raping a girl under 16 cannot get anticipatory bail [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Most recorded victims are close to the line at 18. Of 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded in 2024, 23,497, or 52.7%, were 16 or 17 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 21 and 18: the child marriage law's two ages

The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 uses two ages. A woman is a child until 18; a man is a child until 21. A marriage is a child marriage if either of them is a child [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

That produces strange results. A 20-year-old man reached majority at 18, yet under this Act he is still a child. The same Act then punishes "a male adult above eighteen years of age" who marries a child, with up to two years' rigorous imprisonment, a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, or both [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. So a 20-year-old groom can be a child in one section and an adult offender in another.

A child marriage is also not automatically void. The person who was married as a child can ask a district court to cancel it, but only until two years after reaching majority [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Majority is 18, so the window shuts at 20. For a man, it shuts a full year before the same law stops calling him a child.

## 16: when a child accused can be tried as an adult

Criminal responsibility follows a different map. Under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, when a child aged 16 or above is accused of a "heinous" offence, one with a minimum punishment of seven years or more, the Juvenile Justice Board makes a "preliminary assessment". It can send the case to a Children's Court to be tried as an adult [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. The Act followed the 2015 release of the juvenile convicted in the 2012 Delhi gang rape case, after three years in a correctional home [[tribune-nirbhaya-execution-2020]]. Even when tried as an adult, a child cannot be sentenced to death or to life in prison without the possibility of release [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]].

Here the lines collide. Penetrative sexual assault under POCSO carries at least 10 years [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], so it counts as heinous. A 17-year-old boy is a child whom POCSO protects. If he is accused of penetrative sexual assault on a 16-year-old, he is also a child accused of a heinous offence, and he can face that assessment.

Proving age is a battle of its own. In the Kathua case, the Supreme Court ruled in November 2022 that an accused whom the lower courts had declared a juvenile must be tried as an adult [[scroll-kathua-juvenile-2022]].

## Guardians, abortion and online data: where else the line appears

The line at 18 also decides who signs. Under the MTP Act, an adult woman's own consent is the only one needed for an abortion, but a girl under 18 needs her guardian's written consent [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Because sexual activity under 18 is an offence, the doctor must also inform the police under POCSO. In 2022 the Supreme Court ruled that the doctor need not reveal the girl's identity in that report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Our MTP Act explainer covers the rest of those rules.

Online, the line is 18 again. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 treats everyone under 18 as a child. On paper, a platform must get a parent's verifiable consent before it processes a child's personal data, and may not track children, monitor their behaviour or aim ads at them, though the Act lets the government bring its provisions into force on different dates [[meity-dpdp-act-2023]].

So a 17-year-old's consent does not count for sex, and is not enough on its own for an abortion or for an app to use her data. Yet a 16-year-old accused of a heinous offence can be tried as an adult.

## Why the mismatch matters for families and police

Imagine a 17-year-old girl and a 19-year-old man in Lucknow who run away to marry. Under the child marriage law both are children, because he is under 21. Under the same law he is also an adult who can be jailed for marrying her. Under POCSO and the BNS, any sexual relationship between them is an offence by an adult against a child, and neither her "yes" nor the wedding changes that.

Police have to decide which law applies, and the data does not separate such cases from coercion or grooming. In 2024, in 22,308 POCSO penetrative assault cases, or 50.6%, the accused was a friend, online friend or live-in partner "on pretext of marriage" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That one column mixes grooming by online contacts with relationships between teenagers, and the table cannot say how many cases are which.

For families, the lesson is practical. A child's age decides what the law sees, not a wedding, a "yes" or a family agreement. Learn the lines now, not in a police station.
who-is-a-child-indian-law.hg:
17 saal ka koi bhi bachcha legally sex ke liye haan nahi keh sakta. 20 saal ka ladka shaadi ke maamle mein abhi bhi "child" hai. Aur kisi serious crime ke aaropi 16 saal ke teenager par adult ki tarah trial chal sakta hai. Yeh teeno baatein India mein ek saath sach hain, kyunki har kanoon ne bachpan ki line apni-apni umar par kheenchi hai. Yahan humne yeh saari lines ek jagah rakhi hain, aur bataya hai ki yeh mismatch kyun matter karta hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## 18: sex aur consent ki line

Sexual offences ke maamle mein line 18 ki hai. POCSO Act 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, chahe ladka ho ya ladki [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 batata hai ki kin halaat mein sex rape maana jaayega, aur unmein se ek hai: "with or without her consent, when she is under eighteen years of age" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yaani ladki 18 se kam ki hai toh uska consent ho ya na ho, yeh rape hai. BNS ka rape section sirf auraton aur ladkiyon ko protect karta hai, isliye ladkon ki protection POCSO se aati hai.

Yeh line pehle bhi khisak chuki hai. 2013 tak rape law mein yeh umar 16 thi; us saal ke criminal law amendment ne ise 18 kar diya [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Shaadi karne se bhi yeh umar kam nahi hoti. 2017 mein Supreme Court ke Independent Thought faisle ke baad se 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex bhi rape hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. BNS mein bhi yahi rule hai: marital exception sirf us wife par lagu hota hai jo "not being under eighteen years of age" ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Bachpan ke andar bhi kanoon ne aur lines kheenchi hain. 16 saal se kam umar ki ladki se rape par kam se kam 20 saal ki rigorous imprisonment hai; 12 saal se kam umar ki ladki se rape par yahi saza ya phir death penalty [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 16 se kam umar ki ladki se rape ke accused ko anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Record hue zyadatar victims 18 ki line ke kareeb hain. 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims record hue, jinmein se 23,497, yaani 52.7%, 16 ya 17 saal ke the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 21 aur 18: child marriage law ki do umrein

Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 mein do alag umrein hain. Ladki 18 saal tak child hai, aur ladka 21 saal tak. Agar dono mein se koi ek bhi child hai, toh woh shaadi child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

Isse ajeeb situations banti hain. 20 saal ka ladka 18 par hi majority tak pahunch chuka hai, phir bhi is Act mein woh child hai. Aur yahi Act aage "a male adult above eighteen years of age" ko bachche se shaadi karne par saza deta hai: 2 saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment, 1 lakh rupaye tak fine, ya dono [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Yaani 20 saal ka dulha ek section mein child hai aur doosre section mein adult offender.

Child marriage apne aap void bhi nahi hoti. Jiski shaadi bachpan mein hui, woh district court mein shaadi cancel karwane ki petition daal sakta hai, lekin sirf majority ke 2 saal ke andar [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Majority ki umar 18 hai, toh yeh window 20 par band ho jaati hai. Ladke ke liye iska matlab hai ki window 20 par band, jabki yahi kanoon use 21 tak child maanta hai.

## 16: jab accused bachche ka trial adult ki tarah ho sakta hai

Criminal responsibility ka map alag hai. Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 ke hisaab se agar 16 saal ya usse bade bachche par kisi "heinous" offence ka aarop hai, yaani aisa crime jiski minimum saza 7 saal ya usse zyada ho, toh Juvenile Justice Board pehle ek "preliminary assessment" karta hai. Board case ko Children's Court bhej sakta hai, jahan uska trial adult ki tarah ho [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]]. Yeh Act 2012 ke Delhi gang rape case ke juvenile convict ki 2015 mein release ke baad aaya, jo teen saal correctional home mein reh kar chhoota tha [[tribune-nirbhaya-execution-2020]]. Adult ki tarah trial hone par bhi kisi bachche ko death penalty ya bina release ki ummeed wali life imprisonment nahi di ja sakti [[gazette-juvenile-justice-act-2015]].

Yahan lines aapas mein takraati hain. POCSO mein penetrative sexual assault ki saza kam se kam 10 saal hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], isliye yeh heinous offence gina jaata hai. Ab 17 saal ke ek ladke ke baare mein sochiye. POCSO use child maan kar protect karta hai. Lekin agar us par 16 saal ke kisi bachche par penetrative sexual assault ka aarop lage, toh woh heinous offence ka accused child bhi hai, aur uska bhi woh assessment ho sakta hai.

Umar prove karna apne aap mein ek ladaai hai. Kathua case mein Supreme Court ne November 2022 mein faisla diya ki jis accused ko lower courts ne juvenile maana tha, uska trial adult ki tarah hoga [[scroll-kathua-juvenile-2022]].

## Guardian, abortion aur online data: 18 ki line aur kahan-kahan

18 ki line yeh bhi tay karti hai ki sign kaun karega. MTP Act mein adult aurat ko abortion ke liye sirf apna consent chahiye, lekin 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke liye guardian ka written consent zaroori hai [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. 18 se kam umar mein sexual activity offence hai, isliye doctor ko POCSO ke under police ko bhi batana hota hai. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki agar ladki aur uske guardian kahein, toh doctor ko us report mein ladki ki identity batane ki zaroorat nahi hai [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Abortion ke baaki rules humare MTP Act explainer mein simple words mein hain.

Online bhi line 18 ki hai. Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai. Paper par rule yeh hai ki koi bhi platform bachche ka personal data use karne se pehle parent ka verifiable consent lega, aur bachchon ko track nahi karega, unke behaviour ko monitor nahi karega, aur unhe target karke ads nahi dikhayega. Lekin Act sarkar ko yeh chhoot deta hai ki woh iske provisions alag-alag tareekhon se lagu kare [[meity-dpdp-act-2023]].

Yaani 17 saal ki ladki ki "haan" sex ke liye maayne hi nahi rakhti, aur abortion ya kisi app ko apna data dene ke liye akele uski marzi kaafi nahi hai. Phir bhi heinous offence ke aaropi 16 saal ke teenager ka trial adult ki tarah ho sakta hai.

## Yeh mismatch families aur police ke liye kyun matter karta hai

Sochiye, Lucknow mein 17 saal ki ek ladki aur 19 saal ka ek ladka shaadi karne ke liye ghar se bhaag jaate hain. Child marriage law mein dono child hain, kyunki ladka 21 se kam ka hai. Lekin isi kanoon mein woh adult bhi hai, jise usse shaadi karne par jail ho sakti hai. POCSO aur BNS ke hisaab se in dono ke beech koi bhi sexual relationship ek adult ka child ke against offence hai, aur ladki ki "haan" ya shaadi isse nahi badalti.

Police ko decide karna padta hai ki kaun sa kanoon lagega, aur data aise cases ko zabardasti ya grooming wale cases se alag nahi karta. 2024 mein POCSO ke penetrative assault ke 22,308 cases, yaani 50.6%, mein accused victim ka friend, online friend ya "on pretext of marriage" live-in partner tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Is ek column mein online grooming karne wale log bhi hain aur teenagers ke aapsi rishte bhi, aur table yeh nahi bata sakti ki kaun sa case kis tarah ka hai.

Families ke liye seekh seedhi hai. Kanoon bachche ki umar dekhta hai, shaadi, "haan" ya family ka aapsi samjhauta nahi. Yeh lines abhi samajh lijiye, police station pahunch kar nahi.

working-with-children-conduct-rules.en:
Imagine you are 20, a college student in Jaipur, teaching maths to three Class 8 students in the evenings. Or you coach under-12 cricket on Sundays, help at a summer camp, babysit or volunteer at an NGO's reading class. Parents hand you their children because you are known and liked. Abusers use exactly that position. In 2024, 16,668 cases of penetrative sexual assault on children under POCSO named a family friend, neighbour, employer or other known person as the accused [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Here are the rules that keep children safe with you and your conduct beyond question, and what to do when someone else breaks them. This guide is general information, not legal advice.

## Why good intentions are not enough

Darkness to Light, a US child-protection nonprofit, describes grooming as a deliberate process by which an offender gradually builds and keeps a secret sexual relationship with a child. Its red flags are special attention to one child, gift giving, touching or hugging, being a sympathetic listener, offering to help the family, and gaining access through the internet [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

Now read that list as a tutor. Staying back for the weak student, a birthday gift, a hug after a match, being the one adult a lonely teenager confides in: a kind adult can do each of these with no bad intent. That is why grooming works: from outside, it looks like dedication.

Children, parents and colleagues see only your behaviour, not your intentions. Rules you follow every time, with every child, leave no gap to exploit and make your conduct easy to vouch for.

## Rules for one-to-one time, messages and touch

- **Be visible and interruptible.** Teach at a shared table or with the door open, with another adult nearby. Never be the only adult with one child behind a closed door, in a car or in a changing room.
- **No private favourites.** Extra help goes to small groups, in normal hours, and parents know about it.
- **Gifts go to the group.** Praise, sweets and prizes are given openly to everyone. No private gifts, no money, no rides that parents did not arrange.
- **Touch in public, and only what the child starts.** A high-five or a side hug the child offers is fine. No lap-sitting, tickling, massages or kisses. For hands-on correction in sport, explain, ask, and do it where others can see.
- **No secrets.** Never ask a child to hide anything from their parents. "This stays between us" is a groomer's sentence.
- **No comments** on a child's body, looks or "maturity".

## Online classes and chats with students

Online, one-to-one time happens on a screen nobody else sees. Keep classes in groups or with a parent nearby, and ask students to join from a shared room, not a bedroom. Message through parents or a class group that includes them. No private chats on Instagram or Snapchat, late-night messages, disappearing messages or requests for photos.

Section 67B of the IT Act punishes enticing children, meaning anyone under 18, into online sexual relationships, as well as creating, collecting, browsing, downloading or exchanging sexual material involving them. A first conviction carries up to five years in prison and a Rs 10 lakh fine; a repeat conviction, up to seven years [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

If a student sends you a sexual image of themselves or anyone else, do not save or forward it, not even to a colleague as proof. Tell the parent or your coordinator, and report it at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

## If a child tells you, or you see a colleague cross a line

If a child discloses abuse, stay calm, believe them and do not ask leading questions such as "Did he touch you there?" Do not promise secrecy; say you will tell only people whose job is to help. Write down the child's exact words, the date and who was present, and report it the same day.

A colleague crossing a line is harder, because you will doubt what you saw. Consider a fellow coach who drives one boy home alone every week, messages him at midnight and gives him gifts the others do not get. That is not proof of abuse, but a cluster of red flags aimed at one child, and it needs action.

Note what you saw, with dates, and give it in writing to the person in charge. Do not confront the colleague alone or discuss it in staff WhatsApp groups. If you fear abuse has happened or is about to, the duty is yours, not only the institution's: under POCSO, anyone who knows or suspects that a child sexual offence has been or is likely to be committed must report it to the Special Juvenile Police Unit or the local police [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Unsure where to go? Call 1098, the Child Helpline linked to 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## What the law expects of you

- **Report, even against your own institution.** Failing to report or record a case can mean up to 6 months in prison or a fine. The head of a coaching centre, school, academy or NGO who fails to report abuse by someone working under them faces up to 1 year and a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. "We handled it internally" is not reporting.
- **Trust makes it worse in law.** Under BNS Section 64, rape by a relative, guardian or teacher is one of the aggravated forms, punishable with 10 years to imprisonment for the rest of natural life [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Under POCSO, penetrative sexual assault on a child under 16 has carried a minimum of 20 years since 2019 [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].
- **A student's "yes" changes nothing.** POCSO protects every child under 18, girls and boys alike [[pocso-act-2012]], and since 2013 sex with a girl under 18 has been rape regardless of consent [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. A "relationship" with a 16- or 17-year-old student is not a grey area.

These rules do not make you a suspect. They make you an adult a child is safe with, and one who acts when others do not.
working-with-children-conduct-rules.hg:
Imagine kijiye ki aap 20 saal ke hain, Jaipur mein college student, aur shaam ko Class 8 ke teen bachchon ko maths padhaate hain. Ya aap Sunday ko under-12 cricket coaching dete hain, summer camp mein madad karte hain, babysitting karte hain ya kisi NGO ki reading class mein volunteer karte hain. Parents apne bachche aapko isliye saunpte hain kyunki log aapko jaante hain aur pasand karte hain. Abusers bhi theek isi position ka fayda uthaate hain. 2024 mein POCSO ke under bachchon par penetrative sexual assault ke 16,668 cases mein accused koi family friend, padosi, employer ya doosra jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yahan woh rules hain jo aapke saath bachchon ko safe rakhte hain aur aapke bartaav ko har shak se upar, aur yeh bhi ki jab koi aur rules tode toh kya karein. Yeh guide general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Achchi neeyat kaafi kyun nahi

Darkness to Light, US ki ek child-protection nonprofit, grooming ko ek soch-samajhkar kiya gaya process batati hai, jismein abuser dheere-dheere bachche ke saath ek secret sexual rishta banata hai aur use chhupaye rakhta hai. Iske red flags hain: kisi ek bachche par special attention, gifts dena, chhoona ya hug karna, hamdard listener banna, family ki madad ki offer, aur internet ke zariye pahunch [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

Ab is list ko ek tutor ki nazar se padhiye. Kamzor student ke liye class ke baad ruk jaana, birthday gift, match ke baad hug, kisi akele teenager ka woh ek adult ban jaana jisse woh dil ki baat kehta hai: ek bhala insaan inmein se har cheez bina kisi buri neeyat ke kar sakta hai. Isiliye grooming kaam karti hai: bahar se yeh dedication jaisi dikhti hai.

Bachche, parents aur colleagues sirf aapka bartaav dekhte hain, aapki neeyat nahi. Jo rules aap har baar, har bachche ke saath maante hain, woh kisi ko fayda uthaane ki jagah nahi chhodte, aur aapke bartaav ki gawahi dena aasaan bana dete hain.

## Akele mein waqt, messages aur chhoone ke rules

- **Dikhte rahiye, aur beech mein aane ki gunjaish rakhiye.** Common table par ya khule darwaze ke saath padhaiye, aas-paas koi aur adult ho. Band darwaze ke peeche, car mein ya changing room mein kisi ek bachche ke saath akele adult kabhi mat rahiye.
- **Chupke se koi favourite nahi.** Extra help chhote groups mein, normal time par, aur parents ki jaankari mein.
- **Gifts poore group ke liye.** Taareef, mithai aur inaam sabko, sabke saamne. Private gifts nahi, paise nahi, aisi lift nahi jo parents ne tay na ki ho.
- **Chhoona sirf sabke saamne, aur utna hi jitna bachcha khud shuru kare.** Bachcha khud high-five ya side hug de toh theek hai. God mein bithana, gudgudi, massage ya kiss nahi. Sports mein haath se technique theek karni ho toh pehle samjhaiye, poochhiye, aur aisi jagah kariye jahan doosre dekh sakein.
- **Koi secret nahi.** Bachche se kabhi parents se kuch chhupaane ko mat kahiye. "Yeh baat hum dono ke beech rahegi" groomer ka vaakya hai.
- **Koi comment nahi** bachche ki body, looks ya "maturity" par.

## Online classes aur students ke saath chats

Online, akele mein waqt ek aisi screen par beetta hai jise koi aur nahi dekhta. Classes group mein rakhiye ya aas-paas koi parent ho, aur students se kahiye ki bedroom se nahi, kisi common kamre se join karein. Parents ke through ya aise class group mein message kariye jismein woh bhi hon. Instagram ya Snapchat par private chats, late-night messages, disappearing messages ya photos ki maang, kuch bhi nahi.

IT Act ka Section 67B bachchon ko, yaani 18 saal se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ko, online sexual relationship mein phansaane ko saza ke laayak jurm maanta hai, aur unse jude sexual material ko banana, ikattha karna, browse karna, download karna ya share karna bhi. Pehli conviction par paanch saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10 lakh tak ka fine ho sakta hai; dobara conviction par saat saal tak ki jail [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Agar koi student aapko apni ya kisi aur ki sexual image bheje, toh use save ya forward mat kariye, sabut ke taur par kisi colleague ko bhi nahi. Parent ya apne coordinator ko bataiye, aur cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par report kariye [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

## Agar bachcha kuch bataye, ya koi colleague line paar kare

Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh shaant rahiye, us par bharosa kariye, aur "Kya usne tumhe yahan chhua?" jaise leading sawaal mat poochhiye. Secret rakhne ka vaada mat kariye; kahiye ki aap sirf unhi logon ko batayenge jinka kaam madad karna hai. Bachche ke exact shabd, tareekh aur kaun-kaun maujood tha, yeh likh lijiye, aur usi din report kariye.

Kisi colleague ka line paar karna zyada mushkil hota hai, kyunki aapko apni hi aankhon par shak hoga. Sochiye, ek saathi coach har hafte ek ladke ko akele ghar chhodta hai, use aadhi raat ko message karta hai, aur use aise gifts deta hai jo baaki bachchon ko nahi milte. Yeh abuse ka sabut nahi hai, lekin ek hi bachche par tike kai red flags hain, aur is par action zaroori hai.

Jo dekha, tareekh ke saath note kariye, aur likhkar incharge ko dijiye. Colleague se akele mein mat bhidiye, aur staff ke WhatsApp groups mein iski charcha mat kariye. Agar aapko darr hai ki abuse ho chuka hai ya hone wala hai, toh zimmedari aapki apni hai, sirf institution ki nahi: POCSO ke under, jise bhi pata ho ya shak ho ki kisi bachche ke khilaaf sexual offence hua hai ya hone ki sambhavna hai, use Special Juvenile Police Unit ya local police ko report karna hoga [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Samajh na aaye ki kahan jaayein? 1098 par call kariye, jo 112 se judi Child Helpline hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

## Kanoon aapse kya ummeed karta hai

- **Report kariye, chahe apne hi institution ke khilaaf ho.** Report na karna ya case record na karna 6 mahine tak ki jail ya fine dila sakta hai. Coaching centre, school, academy ya NGO ka head, jo apne under kaam karne wale ke abuse ki report nahi karta, use 1 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. "Humne andar hi sambhal liya" report karna nahi hai.
- **Bharose ki position kanoon mein jurm ko aur gambhir banati hai.** BNS Section 64 ke under, kisi rishtedaar, guardian ya teacher ka kiya rape aggravated forms mein se ek hai, jiski saza 10 saal se lekar baaki poori zindagi ki qaid tak hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. POCSO ke under, 2019 se 16 saal se chhote bachche par penetrative sexual assault ki kam se kam saza 20 saal hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].
- **Student ki "haan" se kuch nahi badalta.** POCSO 18 saal se kam umar ke har bachche ko bachata hai, ladkiyon aur ladkon dono ko [[pocso-act-2012]], aur 2013 se 18 saal se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex, consent ho ya na ho, rape hai [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. 16 ya 17 saal ke student ke saath "relationship" koi grey area nahi hai.

Yeh rules aapko suspect nahi banate. Yeh aapko aisa adult banate hain jiske saath bachcha safe hai, aur jo tab action leta hai jab baaki nahi lete.
